exposure: large niche (residual myometrium thickness <3.0 mm) after caesarean section
symptom relief as main goal of the intervention
distorted anatomy and to restore anatomy as main goal for the intervention
outcome: Scores for subdomains of SF-36 (physical functioning, bodily pain, general health, vitality, mental health, social functioning)
cohort: 129 women with a large niche (residual myometrium thickness <3.0 mm) after caesarean section who underwent laparoscopic niche resection
finding: Laparoscopic niche resection improves both physical and mental aspects of HRQOL at three and twelve months postoperatively in women with a large niche after cesarean section.
